svg.title: Artificial intelligence contains machine learning, which contains deep learning
svg.desc: Three nested boxes. The outermost is artificial intelligence, which includes search, optimisation, reasoning and planning as well as learning. Inside it is machine learning, where performance improves from data or experience. Inside that is deep learning, built on multi-layer neural networks.
svg.text: THREE WORDS THAT ARE NOT SYNONYMS
search, optimisation, reasoning, planning — Weeks 2 to 6 were AI too
performance improves from data or experience, not from case-by-case rules we wrote
machine learning built on multi-layer neural networks
not taught in CT319 this semester, but this is where it sits
Deep learning is machine learning. Machine learning is part of AI. AI is not only machine learning.
